about_the_game:
Crown Your Legacy

Impart a regal flair to your rule with Crowns of the World, a royal collection of cosmetic options to enhance your ruler’s appearance. 

Crowns of the World includes:

  • 6 Stunning Crowns: Display the might of your sovereignty with a new set of crowns from around the world.

  • 4 Hairstyles & 2 Beards: Customize your ruler with refined hairstyles and facial hair options, ideal for adding a personal touch to your royal portrait.

This pack is exclusively available to download when you buy the Chapter IV Expansion Pass for Crusader Kings III.
